description: Data feeding the reminder type classifier. 'known_biller_sender_ids' are literal utility/telecom/broadband sender ids (after TRAI normalization) whose bill mentions are trusted; the app assembles them into a case-insensitive alternation with every id regex-escaped. 'insurer_name_patterns' and 'bill_domain_patterns' are case-insensitive regex FRAGMENTS OR-ed together by the app with an (?i) prefix: keep fragments simple (word boundaries, \s+ between words), never nest quantifiers. Scoring, thresholds and tie-breaks stay in code; only pattern content lives here. Only public brand/sender names belong in this file.
